purpose: Gated all-arm mechanism collection; no learned-policy or Jev-effect claim
review_gate: Launch only after development review accepts checkpoint eligibility, calculation content, task difficulty, replay validity and runtime. No automatic stage promotion.
enrollment: Attempt the fixed index range once; preserve every initial generation, skip and incomplete action. Do not replace ineligible problems.
checkpoint: First emitted newline at or after 256 tokens, at most 384 tokens, before FINAL:. Require actual checkpoint finish reason; no retrospective trimming.
state_segmentation: Prior paragraphs as history; last retained paragraph, possibly partial, as latest_segment. Split only retained text at its last double newline after stripping trailing whitespace.
seeds: Fixed distinct arm/replicate seeds; no common-random-number claim.
interpretation: Repeated continuations are clustered within original problems. All-arm outcomes do not evaluate a sequential Jev-guided policy.
